display.purpose: The hero headline only. Bodoni Moda variable with opsz driven to 96; text-wrap: balance; leading crushed to 0.84.

display-lg.purpose: Section headings such as 'Selected work'. Same face and axis setting, one step down.

display-accent.purpose: Exactly one italic amber word inside a display line. Weight drops to 400 and tracking returns to 0 to compensate for the italic fit.

statement.purpose: The about statement, stepping 2.1rem / 3rem / 4.4rem at a 22-28ch measure so it breaks as a poster, not a paragraph.

headline.purpose: The contact headline, the page's second-largest typographic moment.

title.purpose: Project row names, stepping 1.75rem / 2.25rem / 3rem. Chalk at rest, amber on hover or keyboard focus.

title-sm.purpose: The owner name in the about column, at 1.875rem / 2.25rem.

body.purpose: Manrope. Lead and running prose in mute, capped at 46-68ch depending on column.

body-small.purpose: Project blurbs, hero meta answers, footer and social links.

label.purpose: Every micro-label: hero meta keys, nav links, stack lists, timezone, footer credit. Uppercase, 0.22em, faint.

wordmark.purpose: WEBLOOM in nav and footer, extrabold at 0.3em, followed by a 4px mint dot. The intro curtain sets the same wordmark at 0.42em.

shadows.name: cover-drop
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the build. Desktop sticky cover panel only; reads as the photograph held slightly off the page.

motion.name: ease-expo
motion.purpose: Reveals, filter transitions, cursor state changes, field cross-fades.

motion.name: kinetic-char
motion.value: gsap expo.out, 1.15s, stagger 0.014s from start, yPercent 108 -> 0, rotateX -55deg -> 0
motion.purpose: Per-character display reveal out of per-word masks.

motion.name: kinetic-word
motion.purpose: Whole-word variant for passages long enough that a per-character stagger reads as a loading bar.

motion.name: field-crossfade
motion.purpose: Baked PNG layers fading out once html.shader-live is stamped.

motion.name: nav-materialise
motion.purpose: Nav background, border and 24px backdrop blur fading in past 24px of scroll.

motion.name: cover-crossfade
motion.purpose: Sticky cover swapping between active projects.

motion.name: cover-untame
motion.purpose: Project cover releasing to full colour on engagement at desktop.

motion.name: drift-loops
motion.purpose: The three baked aurora layers; transform only, never filter.

motion.name: sweep-down
motion.purpose: The amber bar inside the scroll-hint capsule.

motion.name: cursor-lerp
motion.purpose: Ring trailing the exact dot; scale lerps at the same rate to 2.1x over interactive targets.

motion.name: magnetic-lerp
motion.purpose: The contact CTA mark, and nothing else.

motion.name: tilt
motion.value: 0.07 per frame, max 7.5deg on each axis, 30px translateZ, 1200px perspective
motion.purpose: The desktop sticky cover, driven from pointer position across the whole viewport.

motion.name: reduced-motion-clamp
motion.purpose: Global kill under prefers-reduced-motion, on top of the shader, curtain, cursor and kinetic opt-outs.

components.name: Wordmark
components.description: WEBLOOM plus a mint dot; the dot scales 2.2x on hover while the text goes amber.
components.css: .ds-wordmark { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Manrope', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.3em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-chalk, #eef2fa); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-wordmark-dot { width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-mint, #00ffe0); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-wordmark:hover { color: var(--color-amber, #ffab00); } .ds-wordmark:hover .ds-wordmark-dot { transform: scale(2.2); } .ds-wordmark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-mint, #00ffe0); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: A tracked-out micro-label in faint that goes chalk on hover. No active-section state is drawn.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 0; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Manrope', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-faint, #6f7c9c); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--color-chalk, #eef2fa); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-mint, #00ffe0); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Availability Pill
components.description: Full-round chip on 60% shelf with a pinging mint dot. One instance only: hero below 768px, nav at and above it.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 6px 14px 6px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #1a2133); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-shelf, #090d18) 60%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Manrope', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: var(--color-mute, #929fba); } .ds-pill-dot { position: relative; display: inline-flex; width: 6px; height: 6px; } .ds-pill-dot i { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-mint, #00ffe0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 var(--color-mint, #00ffe0); animation: ds-ping 1.8s cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-ping { 70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(0,255,224,0); } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(0,255,224,0); } }

components.name: Display Line
components.description: The poster headline: Bodoni Moda with opsz driven to 96, carrying exactly one amber italic word.
components.css: .ds-display { font-family: var(--font-display, 'Bodoni Moda', ui-serif, Didot, Georgia, serif); font-weight: 500; font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 96; letter-spacing: -0.015em; line-height: 0.92; text-wrap: balance; color: var(--color-chalk, #eef2fa); margin: 0; } .ds-display-xl { font-size: clamp(3.6rem, 12.5vw, 11.5rem); line-height: 0.84; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-accent { font-family: var(--font-accent, 'Bodoni Moda', ui-serif, Georgia, serif); font-style: italic; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--color-amber, #ffab00); }

components.name: Kinetic Word Mask
components.description: The per-word mask a display reveal rises out of. The mask is the word, not the line, so it survives any wrap.
components.html: Riseup
components.css: .ds-k-root { display: inline; font-family: var(--font-display, 'Bodoni Moda', ui-serif, Didot, Georgia, serif); font-weight: 500; font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 96; font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 7vw, 6rem); line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: var(--color-chalk, #eef2fa); } .ds-k-word { display: inline-block; overflow: hidden; vertical-align: bottom; padding-bottom: 0.14em; margin-bottom: -0.14em; margin-right: 0.24em; perspective: 700px; } .ds-k-char { display: inline-block; will-change: transform; animation: ds-rise 1.15s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both; } .ds-k-word:nth-child(2) .ds-k-char { animation-delay: 0.08s; } @keyframes ds-rise { from { transform: translateY(108%) rotateX(-55deg); } to { transform: none; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-k-char { animation: none; } }

components.name: Work Row
components.description: The refusal of the card grid: a hairline-bottomed full-width row whose title and arrow go amber together.
components.html: Northlight StudioA booking site for a photography studio, rebuilt around a single availability calendar.Next.js · TypeScript · Postgres
components.css: .ds-work-row { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; padding: 56px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line, #1a2133); text-decoration: none; } .ds-work-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; } .ds-work-title { font-family: var(--font-display, 'Bodoni Moda', ui-serif, Didot, Georgia, serif); font-weight: 500; font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 96; font-size: 3rem; line-height: 0.92; letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: var(--color-chalk, #eef2fa); transition: color 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-work-arrow { color: var(--color-mute, #929fba); transition: color 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-work-blurb { max-width: 58ch; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Manrope', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.625; color: var(--color-mute, #929fba); } .ds-work-stack { font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Manrope', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-faint, #6f7c9c); } .ds-work-row:hover .ds-work-title, .ds-work-row:focus-visible .ds-work-title { color: var(--color-amber, #ffab00); } .ds-work-row:hover .ds-work-arrow, .ds-work-row:focus-visible .ds-work-arrow { color: var(--color-amber, #ffab00); transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-work-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-mint, #00ffe0); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Email CTA
components.description: The page's only primary action: an amber circle (the one magnetic element) beside the address, underlined in hairline navy.
components.html: hello@example.com
components.css: .ds-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-cta-mark { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 64px; height: 64px; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-amber, #ffab00); color: var(--color-void, #05070e); transition: transform 0.5s ease-out; } .ds-cta-text { font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Manrope', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 2.25rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--color-chalk, #eef2fa); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--color-line, #1a2133); text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.3em; transition: color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), text-decoration-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-cta:hover .ds-cta-mark { transform: scale(1.1); } .ds-cta:hover .ds-cta-text { color: var(--color-amber, #ffab00); text-decoration-color: var(--color-amber, #ffab00); } .ds-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-mint, #00ffe0); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Scroll Hint
components.description: The secondary affordance: a hairline capsule with an amber bar sweeping down on a 2.4s loop.
components.css: .ds-hint { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Manrope', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-chalk, #eef2fa); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-hint-capsule { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: flex-start; width: 24px; height: 40px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-faint, #6f7c9c) 60%, transparent); transition: border-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-hint-bar { display: block; margin-top: 8px; width: 3px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-amber, #ffab00); animation: ds-sweep 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-sweep { from { transform: translateY(-100%); } to { transform: translateY(320%); } } .ds-hint:hover { color: var(--color-amber, #ffab00); } .ds-hint:hover .ds-hint-capsule { border-color: var(--color-amber, #ffab00); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-hint-bar { animation: none; } }

components.name: Sticky Cover Panel
components.description: The only element in the build that carries a shadow, a radius and 3D rotation. Desktop work rail only.
components.css: .ds-cover { perspective: 1200px; perspective-origin: 50% 50%; width: 320px; } .ds-cover-inner { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #1a2133); background: var(--color-shelf, #090d18); box-shadow: 0 30px 70px -28px rgba(2,4,10,0.9); transform-style: preserve-3d; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); filter: saturate(0.5) brightness(0.8); } .ds-cover:hover .ds-cover-inner { transform: rotateX(-4deg) rotateY(6deg) translateZ(24px); filter: none; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-cover-inner { transition: none; } .ds-cover:hover .ds-cover-inner { transform: none; } }

components.name: Custom Cursor
components.description: Trailing ring plus exact dot in difference blend; amber ring over interactive targets. Never shown on coarse pointers or reduced motion.
components.css: .ds-cursor-stage { position: relative; height: 60px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 40px; } .ds-cursor-ring { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(238,242,250,0.6); mix-blend-mode: difference; transition: border-color 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-cursor-ring[data-on="true"] { border-color: var(--color-amber, #ffab00); background-color: rgba(255,171,0,0.1); transform: scale(2.1); } .ds-cursor-dot { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-chalk, #eef2fa); mix-blend-mode: difference; } @media (hover: none), (pointer: coarse), (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-cursor-ring, .ds-cursor-dot { display: none; } }

components.name: Field Scrim
components.description: The vignette and floor that keep type off the brightest part of the field. Paints above every atmospheric layer at z-index 1.
components.css: .ds-scrim { position: relative; height: 220px; background: radial-gradient(60% 80% at 30% 20%, #123a9e 0%, #05070e 70%); overflow: hidden; } .ds-scrim-vignette { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(130% 92% at 62% 0%, transparent 30%, rgba(5,7,14,0.34) 62%, rgba(5,7,14,0.86) 100%); } .ds-scrim-floor { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 52%; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, rgba(5,7,14,0.7) 55%, #05070e); }

narrative.overview:
WEBLOOM is a single dark room with one light source in it. The ground is a deep navy-black that is never pure black, and behind everything the aurora burns — on capable desktops as live domain-warped noise on the GPU, everywhere else as pre-blurred transparent PNGs drifting on slow loops. Film grain lies over the whole surface at 3.2% opacity, which is both the room's texture and the thing that kills gradient banding on a dark ground. Every element of content sits on that atmosphere at z-index: 10; nothing gets its own box.

The display voice is a Didone. Bodoni Moda is loaded variable with the optical-size axis exposed and pushed to "opsz" 96 at display scale, because a didone's entire character is the hairline-to-stem contrast and that contrast collapses if opsz is left tracking a body size. Manrope does everything below the display line: prose, labels, the wordmark, UI. The single amber italic word inside each display line survives from the previous world and is still the signature — it is now the same family as its host line, differing only in style, weight and tracking, which makes it read as an inflection rather than a collision.

The system's density is editorial, not app-like. There are no cards: work is a list of large typographic rows separated by hairlines, capabilities are a definition list separated by hairlines, and the only rectangles with corners on them are photographs of real sites. The palette is deliberately two-accent — amber acts, mint measures — and no third hue is admitted, which is why real project screenshots rest desaturated and why the live shader is coloured strictly out of the same five values. The build's confirmed rejection is the resume grid of equal cards.
keyCharacteristics: One aurora field behind everything — live on the GPU where the device can carry it, baked raster everywhere else — and no other background treatment.
Exactly two accents, amber for action and mint for status and focus, on a navy-black ground.
Poster-scale Bodoni Moda with the optical-size axis driven to 96; Manrope for every non-display word.
Hairline rules and wide-tracked micro-labels instead of cards, panels, or fills.
Display type arrives by rising out of per-word masks; everything is visible by default and dead under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Two-Accent Rule
rules.body: Amber and mint are the entire accent vocabulary. A third hue may not enter the page from any source — not from imported imagery, which is why project screenshots rest at reduced saturation, and not from the shader, whose fragment output is mixed only from void, blue-body, mint and amber.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Faint is the darkest text tone the system permits, at 4.83:1 on the void ground. Anything that carries words — labels, stack lists, years, placeholder copy — sits at faint or lighter. No new dimmer neutral gets invented for "quieter" text.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral in the system carries the ground's blue hue. A neutral gray is out of world.

rules.name: The Optical Size Rule
rules.body: Every use of the display face at display scale sets font-variation-settings: "opsz" 96. The hairline-to-stem contrast is the whole reason the face is here, and at a default opsz the letterforms thicken into a generic serif. Correspondingly, the display face is never used below roughly 1.5rem — small Bodoni is unreadable on a dark ground and is what Manrope is for.

rules.name: The One Italic Word Rule
rules.body: A display line gets at most one italic word, and it is always amber. Two italic words in one composition is out of world; the italic never sets a whole line, a paragraph, or a label.

rules.name: The Sans-Below-The-Headline Rule
rules.body: Anything that is not a headline is Manrope: prose, labels, wordmark, buttons, meta, footer. There is no third face, and the serif never runs a sentence.

rules.name: The Label-or-Nothing Rule
rules.body: Small text is either body-small in mute or a 0.22em-tracked uppercase label in faint. There is no third small-text style, and labels are never set in an accent colour.

rules.name: The Word-Mask Rule
rules.body: Display type reveals out of masks that are one word wide, never one line wide, so the effect survives any wrap at any viewport. A revealed line must be verifiable: scripts/kinetic-check.mjs asserts that no split character is left stuck inside a mask anywhere on the page.

rules.name: The Hairline Grid Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px borders in hairline navy, never with background fills, gaps alone, or boxes. A section header is a heading above a border-b; a list is rows with border-b.

rules.name: The Fold Composition Rule
rules.body: Field geometry is authored per breakpoint, not derived from the desktop layout. Any new atmospheric layer specifies its mobile placement explicitly.

rules.name: The Scrim-Above-The-Field Rule
rules.body: The vignette and floor are legibility, not decoration, so they paint above every field layer at z-[1]. A field drawn on top of its own protection puts the headline on a wall of blue; any new atmospheric layer goes under the scrim, never over it.

rules.name: The Enhancement-Not-Foundation Rule
rules.body: The live shader is an enhancement over a design that is complete without it. It boots on requestIdleCallback, only at >=1024px with pointer: fine, never under reduced motion, and fades its own uniform in; when it succeeds it stamps shader-live on <html> and the baked layers cross-fade out over 1.6s. If OGL fails to import or the context fails to create, the PNG field simply stays. Phones get the PNG field by design, not by degradation.

rules.name: The Baked Blur Rule
rules.body: Atmospheric softness in the raster path is baked at build time (scripts/gen-aurora.mjs). A live filter: blur() on a full-bleed layer re-rasterises the whole surface every frame and stalled the compositor hard enough to time out screenshot capture; raw radial gradients avoid the cost but band visibly on the dark ground. Shipped raster atmosphere layers only ever transform.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. The cover drop is the system's entire shadow vocabulary; new components get separation from a hairline or from the ground, not from a shadow.

rules.name: The Visible-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Content ships visible; the js class on <html> is what opts an element into being hidden before its reveal. A failed or blocked script leaves a complete page, never a blank one — which is also why the curtain mounts client-side only and the native cursor is hidden from inside the cursor script.

rules.name: The Rationed Magnetism Rule
rules.body: Magnetic attraction is applied to the contact CTA mark and nothing else. A page where everything is magnetic feels loose; the effect is a reward for reaching the one thing the page wants you to click.

rules.name: The Reduced-Motion Kill Rule
rules.body: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the shader never mounts, the curtain never renders, the custom cursor is display: none and the native pointer is left alone, kinetic characters are set to transform: none and marked ready, drift, sweep, smooth scrolling and reveal transitions are switched off, and every remaining animation and transition is clamped to 0.001ms. Motion is never load-bearing for legibility.

rules.name: The Verified-Craft Rule
rules.body: Every effect that can fail silently has a script that fails loudly: kinetic-check.mjs (no character stranded in a mask), cover-check.mjs (every cover decodes at both widths), sticky-check.mjs (column lengths), shoot.mjs (capture from the production export, not the dev server). A motion effect without a check is not finished.

dos: Do put every new section on the shared container (max-width: 1400px, gutters 20/32/48px) with relative z-10 so it sits above the field stack.
Do set font-variation-settings: "opsz" 96 on any display-scale use of Bodoni Moda, and use Manrope for everything that is not a headline.
Do separate content with 1px hairline-navy rules and let type carry hierarchy.
Do ration the amber italic to one word per display line.
Do keep small text at either body-small in mute or a 0.22em-tracked uppercase label in faint at 4.83:1 or better on the ground.
Do give amber the acting job and mint the measuring job; hover and focus resolve to amber, status and focus rings resolve to mint.
Do mask kinetic reveals per word so they survive a wrap, and let GSAP own a transform with an explicit set before tweening it.
Do paint legibility scrims above every atmospheric layer, and gate GPU and pointer effects behind >=1024px, pointer: fine, idle-time boot and a working fallback.
Do gate every animation behind prefers-reduced-motion and ship content visible without JavaScript.
donts: Don't build a card: no filled panel, no rounded box, no shadowed tile for text content. Rows and rules only.
Don't introduce a third hue. Imported imagery that carries one gets desaturated at rest; the shader mixes only from the world's own five colours.
Don't set the display face below ~1.5rem, or set a sentence, a label or the wordmark in it.
Don't animate display type before document.fonts.ready — the didone's metrics shift on swap and the letters jump.
Don't apply filter: blur() to a full-bleed animated layer.
Don't add a shadow to anything but an image panel; the cover drop is the whole vocabulary.
Don't use a neutral gray, or a text tone dimmer than faint.
Don't use icon fonts or glyph characters — icons are inline stroked SVG at 1.4-1.8 stroke width.
Don't hide the native cursor from CSS alone; only the mounted cursor script may add cursor-custom.
Don't make an enhancement load-bearing: a device without a GPU field, a magnet or a tilt must still get the finished page.
Don't derive mobile atmosphere placement from the desktop composition; author field geometry per breakpoint.
Don't lazy-load an image that can appear in the first screenful or two of a fast scroll.
